summary: Requires the CPUC to adopt data center tariffs by Jan 1, 2028 that assign transmission upgrade costs to data centers, with a 10-year early termination fee; applies to new interconnection agreements from Jan 1, 2027.

source.citation: Governor's office release Sept 22, 2026; CalMatters, KQED, NatLawReview (Sept 22-24, 2026)

notes: CORRECTION: status proposed -> adopted. Signed with six companion bills on Sept 21; earlier calendar item 'Sept 30 Newsom deadline' retired.
